frank: Quick postmortem note: yesterday a resident-tenant request fell back to an alternate region and returned a higher-risk completion. We need a stricter failover handshake.
leila: Briefly: proxy forwarded because node looked healthy. No preflight on artifact capabilities (encryption, behavior, residency).
hiro: Error snippet from runtime: ```FallbackError: mismatch: residency=eu, node_region=us, artifact.behavior_hash!=expected```
ana: (typo) ana: We should formalize a 3-way handshake before any cross-region load: 1) proxy preflight GET /artifact/meta -> returns manifest headers (residency, encryption.scope, behavior_hash, quant_format, abi); 2) node advertises `node.capabilities` in health (accepted_abis, kms_regions, model_formats); 3) proxy evaluates policy matrix and either permit, prefer-local-fallback, or deny.
frank: Agreed. Also propose fallback tiers: tier A = exact parity (same manifest), tier B = local-shadow (distilled in-region), tier C = deferred async (customer-consent required), tier D = block with 451.
leila: Implementation notes: add manifest headers: `X-Artifact-Residency`, `X-Artifact-Behavior-Hash`, `X-Artifact-Encryption-Scope`, `X-Artifact-Quant`; node health adds `X-Node-KMS-Regions` and `X-Node-Accepted-ABIs`. Proxy preflight pseudo: ```meta=GET /meta/{id}; if meta.residency.enforced and node.region!=meta.residency: apply_tiers();```
hiro: For deferred async, we need an ephemeral consent flow: SDK pops modal -> calls /consent -> returns `consent_token`. Proxy enqueues job and returns 202 + Location. All defer ops logged (consent_token, tenant_id, operator_id if used).
ana: security-bot: anything involving cross-region processing or deferred storage must include per-tenant encryption-at-rest using tenant KMS if provided, and immutably log operator actions. No silent rewrap allowed.
frank: Telemetry: `failover.handshake.permitted`, `failover.handshake.denied.reason`, `failover.tierA.count`, `failover.tierB.used`, `deferred.requests.enqueued`, `deferred.completed.latency`. We also need a sampled trace carrying the preflight decision.
leila: Operator playbook: - If tierB spikes -> increase pre-warm budget for distilled models. - If deferred queue grows -> alert SRE and notify tenant with opt-in link. - If handshake.denied spikes -> investigate CI artifact drift.
hiro: Edge-case: private/on-prem tenants with customer-owned KMS -> always treat as residency-enforced; only allow deferred if tenant explicitly enabled cross-region opt-in and provided rewrap policy.
ana: ana: Rollout plan: 1) add manifest headers and node health props behind feature flag; 2) proxy preflight + decision rules (soft mode = log-only), 3) enable tierB local-shadow path + prewarm quota, 4) deferred consent flow and audit trail; 5) strict mode. Pilot with small tenant cohort.
frank: I'll write RFC with matrix examples (residency x encryption x behavior parity) and sample manifest headers. ETA draft: 48h. cc ops + security + legal.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created feature flags `preflight.handshake`, `failover.tierB_enabled`, `deferred.cross_region_enabled` in staging.
security-bot: security-bot: added audit checklist for consent_token creation and deferred storage encryption.
leila: Thanks. Quick action: ops, enable `preflight.handshake` in staging; do not enable strict mode until parity metrics are green.
ops-bot: ops-bot: `preflight.handshake` enabled in staging; strict=false.
frank: Great sync. End of thread.
